mensajes.limite: Preparing this plan does not create sources or accounts or grant permissions. The provider must check private configuration, preimage and approval before applying it.
mensajes.uso_invalido: Provide the source, plan and message catalog. Add --cotejar to check an existing plan.
mensajes.fuente_insegura: The source cannot be read. Use a private file up to 64 KiB in a private directory outside the repository.
mensajes.fuente_invalida: The source does not meet the synthetic initial sources contract or has expired. Check versions, references and validity periods.
mensajes.plan_inseguro: The private plan cannot be read for comparison.
mensajes.plan_divergente: The existing plan differs from the source or its destination is unsafe. It has not been overwritten.
mensajes.plan_preparado: The plan is prepared and its hash has been calculated. Keep it for review.
